items.evidence: Log shows 48 separate pick_up_tip/drop_tip cycles each aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube into a distinct well (A1-H1, A3-H3 ... A11-H11); eluates go to matching columns of the elution plate.
Log lines 14-51 add 40 uL beads then 2x125 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL sample with 5x400 uL mix; delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL supernatant removal to waste with magnet on.
Two 500 uL ethanol additions (3x166.667) each removed with magnet engaged (log 795-1001), then delay 240 s before disengage at line 1003.
Elution is added off-magnet and mixed, with 30 s then engage then 90 s delays, but log lines 1092-1113 recover 100 uL to the elution plate instead of about 80 uL.
Docstring and metadata attribute the work to 'Ambrosi et al.' although the paper is by Lázaro-Perona et al., and the 100 uL recovery deviates from the ~80 uL collect step.

judge.summary: The protocol correctly handles 48 samples, binding/separation and the two ethanol washes with drying, all matching the run log. It fails on elution recovery (100 uL transferred instead of about 80 uL) and fidelity because the metadata misattributes the paper to Ambrosi et al.
